lines.text: Say there is, not there have!
Many learners say: There have a park near my house.
Better: There is a park near my house.
Is! There is a shop here.

data.wrong: There have a park near my house.
data.right: There is a park near my house.
data.memory: There is a park near my house.

native.tip: Türkçede “var” hem “have” hem “there is” demektir; bir yerde bir şey varsa “there is” kullan: “There is a park near my house.”
native.caption: “There have a park near my house” mi diyorsun? 😅 İngilizcede “var” anlamı için “there is” kullanılır, “there have” gelmez. Doğrusu “There is a park near my house.” Ama’yı dinle ve tekrar et! Lexkite uygulamasını aç, daha çok pratik yap.
native.comment: Cevap: “is”. “There” ile “is” gelir. Şimdi kendi cümleni yaz ve sesli söyle: {link}

en.tip: When something is in a place, use “there is,” not “there have”: “There is a park near my house.”
en.caption: Do you say “There have a park near my house”? 😅 When something is in a place, English uses “there is” and not “there have” here. The right sentence is “There is a park near my house.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Open the Lexkite app and practice more.
